# Alphaville: Journal of Film and Screen Media

> A peer-reviewed academic journal publishing rigorous film and screen media criticism with a focus on transnational cinema, decolonial approaches, and critical film studies.

Published by University College Cork, Alphaville is an open-access journal dedicated to advancing scholarly discourse on cinema and visual culture. The journal emphasizes international perspectives, particularly on Latin American cinema, film festivals, and experimental media practices.

## Key Topics

- Latin American cinema
- transnational cinema
- decolonization
- film criticism
- film history
- feminist filmmaking
- film festivals
- art cinema
- visual culture
- academic publishing
- Brazil
- Colombia
- experimental cinema
- documentary
- film archives

## Journal Overview

- [Alphaville: Journal of Film and Screen Media](https://alphavillejournal.com/index.html): Homepage for peer-reviewed journal on film and screen media studies
- [About Alphaville](https://alphavillejournal.com/AboutAlphaville.html): Journal mission and publishing details from University College Cork
- [Alphaville Submissions](https://alphavillejournal.com/Submissions.html): Call for papers and submission guidelines for themed issues
- [Alphaville Contact](https://alphavillejournal.com/Contact.html): Contact information and publication ethics guidelines

## Issue 29-30: Latin American Cinema and Non-Latin American Practitioners

- [Coming to Latin America: Moving Image Encounters, Non-Latin American Practitioners](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/Editorial.html): Editorial on foreign practitioners in Latin American cinema history
- [Sex, Drugs, and Neocolonial Leisure: An Intermedial History and Analysis of Dieter Schidor's Kalt in Kolumbien (1985)](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleVelasquez.html): Analysis of German-Colombian film examining neocolonialism and transnational cinema
- [Foreign Body: AIDS, Moral Panic, and Otherness in Via Appia (1989)](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleRodriguesMarques.html): Study of AIDS representation in Brazilian cinema through German filmmaker lens
- [Transcending Borders? Observing Lesbian Desire and Intimacy in Ruth Caudeli's Porque no. (2016) and Petit Mal (2022)](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleValderramaBurgosFielding.html): Feminist analysis of Spanish filmmaker's lesbian representation in Latin America
- [Displacing the Gaze: Imaging Brazil in Transnational Experimental Cinema and Video Art](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleAndrade.html): Study of female artists' experimental approaches to Brazil representation

## Ethnographic and Documentary Cinema

- [Fragments of Encounters: The Filmic Chronicles of Claude Lévi-Strauss and Dina Dreyfus in Indigenous Villages in Brazil](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleBrumCoutinho.html): Ethnographic film analysis of Lévi-Strauss and Dreyfus's Brazilian research missions
- [Cosmologies of the Living Forest: For a Metabolic Documentary](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleHippe.html): Ecocentric cinema analysis of Ursula Biemann's Indigenous cosmology video works
- [The Other Chronicle of a Summer; or, Caribbean Layovers of Transnational Vérité](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleDoresteRodriguez.html): Cinema vérité analysis of Michel Brault's Puerto Rico film and decolonization

## Transnational Cinema and Extractivism

- ["X" Marks the What? "Cross Influence", Extractivism, and the Labours of Moving Image Excavation in Harun Farocki's The Silver and the Cross (2010)](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleAlexander.html): Video installation analysis examining extractivism and colonial representation
- [From Thailand to Colombia: Soundscapes of a Violent Past in Apichatpong Weerasethakul's Memoria (2021)](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticlePerezOsorio.html): Transnational film analysis of Thai director's Colombian memory and violence

## Feminist Filmmaking and Collaborative Practice

- [Unfinished Thinking and the Unfinished Film: Feminist Filmmaking in Cuba, Catalunya, and Scotland](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleArchibald.html): Collaborative feminist filmmaking project across Cuba, Catalonia, and Scotland

## Special Issues and Archives

- [Introduction: Mapping Screen Heritage](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/DossierIntroduction.html): Overview of decolonial approaches to film and media archival studies
- [Alphaville Issue 28, Moving Beyond the (De)Colonial Container: The Work of Film Festivals. Table of Contents](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue28.html): Journal issue on decolonial approaches to film festivals and knowledge
- [Alphaville Issue 27, 100 Years of Disney. Table of Contents](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue27.html): Journal issue examining Disney's centennial and corporate film history

## Optional

- [Faith and Progress: A Study of Father Colin MacInnes' Work in Gleanntan Ecuador (1995)](https://alphavillejournal.com/Issue2930/HTML/ArticleMino.html): Documentary analysis of Scottish missionary in Ecuador examining colonial tropes
